6.old: Not legal, planning or financial advice. Before you buy or sell, check the zoning, what the community plan says, and which schools serve the address.
6.new: None of this is legal, planning or financial advice. Ahead of any purchase or sale in Aberdeen, look up the zoning and the community plan, and find out which schools cover the address.

12.old: Covers Surrey, Langley (City and Township) and Abbotsford. General information from public municipal and provincial maps, not a survey or legal advice. The address is only used to look up public map data. Prefer to write directly?
12.new: The lookup works for Surrey, Langley (City and Township) and Abbotsford. It provides general details from public provincial and municipal maps, which is no replacement for a survey or legal advice. I use the address only to find public map data. Would you rather write to me directly?

60.old: From the City of Abbotsford, Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley Regional District. Check them for current hours and closures.
60.new: Hours and closures change, so check with the Fraser Valley Regional District, Metro Vancouver or the City of Abbotsford, which is where this information came from.

69.old: On rural land, problems with the water, the septic system or the land rules can cost more to fix than the house.
69.new: Acreage and rural lots can bring water, septic or land-rule problems that cost more to sort out than the house.

82.old: What the zoning allows for farming, and whether BC Assessment lists it as a farm (farm class, which lowers property tax)
82.new: Check what farming the zoning permits, and whether BC Assessment classes the property as a farm. Farm class lowers the property tax.

91.old: Aberdeen has no neighbourhood plan of its own, so the City’s Official Community Plan (OCP) and the ALR rules apply property by property.
91.new: Aberdeen doesn’t have a neighbourhood plan of its own. Instead, the ALR rules and the City’s Official Community Plan (OCP) govern each property separately.

99.old: If the home is on a well, test how much water it gives and how clean it is, and ask for past test results.
99.new: For a home that runs on a well, have the flow tested along with the water quality, and ask whether earlier test results are available.

105.old: Look for any rules or rights that others have over the land (covenants, rights of way and easements), including any access you rely on.
105.new: Find out whether other parties hold rights or restrictions on the land, such as covenants, rights of way and easements, and that includes any access you depend on.

107.old: Rules about how close you can build to a stream can limit where you build. Ask the City of Abbotsford about any watercourse on or near the land.
107.new: Setback rules for streams can restrict where on the lot you can build. Ask the City of Abbotsford whether a watercourse crosses or sits next to the land.
